text:
zoe: quick question for the room: what's one tiny, silly object you'd keep on your desk forever if you had to pick only one? no practicality rules, pure vibes. :grinning:

marc: a tiny plastic T-Rex that roars when you squeeze it. morale booster. :t_rex:

rina: a tea-stained postcard from my grandma. smells like summer. sentimental but also very small. :postcard:

anya: novelty stress ball shaped like a latte. squeezes and calms. :coffee:

zoe: lol love these. would you ever trade it away for a better mouse?

marc: never. trex > better mouse. always.

rina: depends. if the mouse stops me from flaming my laptop during long meetings maybe.

dev-bot: reminder: please log physical desk gifts in the office inventory doc if value > $50 (automated note).

anya: hypothetical follow-up: if you could legally name that object, what would you call it?

marc: "Sir Chompsalot"

rina: "Postcard of Unreasonable Calm"

zoe: "Button of Microjoy"

anya: i'm saving these for a future merch idea. thank you team. :sparkles:

marc: also, unrelated but important: does anyone have a spare sunflower seed snack? low-key craving.

zoe: i have some in my desk. will drop at meeting room B in 10. :seedling:

rina: you are a hero.

zoe: mission accomplished. tiny object trade not included.
